stories.title: Utah Talons Win 2026 AUSL Championship — Back-to-Back Champions

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Back-to-back. 🥎

Utah Talons sweep the Chicago Bandits to win the 2026 AUSL Championship — the first repeat champion in league history.

Talons 6, Bandits 1 in Game 2. Montana Fouts: complete game. Jadelyn Allchin: Series MVP.

History. #UtahTalons #AUSL

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Jadelyn Allchin is your 2026 AUSL Championship Series MVP.

2-run homer. RBI double. 3 RBI in Game 2.

Bri Ellis added a solo shot. Utah Talons win 6-1 to complete the sweep.

Nobody did it like the Talons this year. #UtahTalons #AUSL

stories.title: Montana Fouts Named 2026 AUSL Pitcher of the Year

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Montana Fouts. AUSL Pitcher of the Year. And it wasn't close.

7-4. 2.36 ERA. 63 strikeouts. 7 complete games.

She broke FOUR AUSL single-season records in 2026 — innings pitched, strikeouts, wins, and complete games.

The gold standard. #UtahTalons #AUSL
